name: scene_batch_5
title: Card scenes, batch 5
intro: Keep or reject each scene, in the C and E mix. Each tile is the bare scene over two real cards, a program or event and a building, composed at 300 dpi with the full bleed showing: the program window is the whole scene, the building window its center. Scenes are a pool: the card a scene was written for is a suggestion. The second card only shows the other window. For true size, print art-originals/scenes/b5/cards.pdf at 100%. Use the notes for what to change.

rows.label: 1. Industry: Regulators in a bright hearing room prying a huge interlocked gear machine apart into separate small gears on a long table, owners watching sourly from the benches.
rows.note: Written for Antitrust Action. Shown on Antitrust Action and Market Watchdog. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 2. Industry: A modern trading hall built around one giant brass balance scale, workers on ladders adding counterweights to hold it level while traders below look up.
rows.note: Written for Market Stabilization Board. Shown on Antitrust Action and Market Stabilization Board. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 3. Industry: An inspector on a raised catwalk over a busy warehouse floor, a sturdy robot hound at their side, both watching crates move along the conveyor belts.
rows.note: Written for Market Watchdog. Shown on Supply Chain Audit and Market Watchdog. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 4. Industry: Auditors in hard hats walking a container quay, one shipping container swung open to show crates of chips being counted against a clipboard.
rows.note: Written for Supply Chain Audit. Shown on Supply Chain Audit and Vertical Monopoly. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 5. Industry: A single sprawling industrial complex filling a whole valley, mine, foundry, factory and harbor joined by one continuous covered conveyor in matching company colors.
rows.note: Written for Vertical Monopoly. Shown on Reclamation Crew and Vertical Monopoly. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 6. Industry: A work crew in hard hats prying creeping purple growths off a factory wall and hauling them into skips, the cleaned brick bright behind them.
rows.note: Written for Reclamation Crew. Shown on Reclamation Crew and Market Stabilization Board. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 7. Diplomacy: A bright public atrium of open service counters, citizens queuing calmly while clerks hand back papers, a tall glass wall full of daylight behind them.
rows.note: Written for Civic Trust Bureau. Shown on Fact-Check Network and Civic Trust Bureau. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 8. Diplomacy: Volunteers in matching vests walking a busy market street in pairs, one peeling a fake poster off a wall while shopkeepers nod them on.
rows.note: Written for Civic Watch. Shown on Truth Commission and Civic Watch. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 9. Diplomacy: A busy newsroom of journalists pinning photographs and string across a wall, one holding up a forged photograph torn cleanly in half.
rows.note: Written for Fact-Check Network. Shown on Fact-Check Network and Civic Watch. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 10. Diplomacy: Executives in sharp suits striding into a captured office tower lobby as the occupier's gray-uniformed guards are walked out, a ring of keys handed over at the door.
rows.note: Written for Hostile Buyout. Shown on Hostile Buyout and Civic Trust Bureau. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 11. Diplomacy: A vast crowd of citizens with plain unmarked banners surging up a boulevard toward a fortified city hall, the barricade across its steps giving way.
rows.note: Written for Popular Uprising. Shown on Hostile Buyout and Popular Uprising. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 12. Diplomacy: A round public hearing hall, a witness speaking at a plain lectern while a seated panel listens and a hushed audience fills the tiers around them.
rows.note: Written for Truth Commission. Shown on Truth Commission and Popular Uprising. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 13. Security: Armored vehicles forming a protective ring around a field camp, soldiers raising barriers while a hostile drone tumbles out of the sky overhead.
rows.note: Written for Force Protection Order. Shown on Force Protection Order and Garrison Command. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 14. Security: A fortified command post on a hilltop, officers around a sand-table model of the valley below, a radio mast and sandbagged walls behind them.
rows.note: Written for Garrison Command. Shown on Force Protection Order and Garrison Command. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 15. Security: Peacekeepers in light vehicles rolling through a freed city gate, residents stepping out to greet them, the occupier's barricades shoved aside.
rows.note: Written for Peacekeeping Mission. Shown on Peacekeeping Mission and Sentinel Command. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 16. Security: A wide hilltop base with a watchtower at each corner, radar dishes turning on its roof and patrol vehicles parked in neat rows below.
rows.note: Written for Sentinel Command. Shown on Peacekeeping Mission and Sentinel Command. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 17. Security: Office staff in a calm practiced drill, filing into a shelter while a siren tower turns on the roof and a marshal in an orange vest waves them through.
rows.note: Written for Early Warning Drill. Shown on Early Warning Drill and Aegis Dome Array. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 18. Security: Engineers bolting armor plates onto a ring of emitter towers around a city while a pale hexagonal dome of light flickers on above them, a falling missile glancing off it.
rows.note: Written for Aegis Dome Array. Shown on Early Warning Drill and Aegis Dome Array. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 19. Cyber: A city skyline ringed by tall automated turret pylons and hovering drones, fine green lines of a sensor grid linking them into one net.
rows.note: Written for Autonomous Defense Grid. Shown on Threat Hunt and Autonomous Defense Grid. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 20. Cyber: A hacker team in an open van below a captured city tower, cables run up its wall, the tower's windows flipping from purple back to green floor by floor.
rows.note: Written for Root Access. Shown on Root Access and Security Ops Floor. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 21. Cyber: A security operations floor of analysts at long desks under a wall of abstract green network maps, one standing and pointing at a red flare in the web.
rows.note: Written for Security Ops Floor. Shown on Shadow Broker Scrub and Security Ops Floor. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 22. Cyber: Two analysts walking a bright server aisle, one prying a small spider-like parasite device off a rack while the other sweeps it with a handheld scanner.
rows.note: Written for Threat Hunt. Shown on Threat Hunt and Autonomous Defense Grid. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 23. Cyber: Technicians with handheld scrubbers wiping glowing purple stains off a row of street-side server cabinets, a contact in a long coat handing one of them a slim folder.
rows.note: Written for Shadow Broker Scrub. Shown on Shadow Broker Scrub and Sentinel Mesh. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 24. Cyber: A hillside of small sensor posts joined by a glowing green net, a technician tightening one strand as a dark swarm of drones slows and thins against it.
rows.note: Written for Sentinel Mesh. Shown on Root Access and Sentinel Mesh. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 25. Science: Forensic investigators in white suits sweeping a captured city hall's records room, unplugging purple-glowing servers and boxing them as evidence.
rows.note: Written for Forensic Audit. Shown on Forensic Audit and Sample Repository. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 26. Science: Engineers stress-testing a server cabinet on a shaking rig in a test hall, a shield-shaped frame clamped around it as sparks bounce harmlessly off.
rows.note: Written for Stress Test Suite. Shown on Stress Test Suite and Inference Cluster. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 27. Science: A long hall of humming storage cabinets fed by cables from antenna dishes outside the windows, an archivist holding up a printed chart to warn the room.
rows.note: Written for Telemetry Archive. Shown on Field Grant and Telemetry Archive. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 28. Science: A vast vault of glowing storage drawers cut into a mountainside, a forklift hauling crates of drives out to a buyer's waiting truck.
rows.note: Written for Exabyte Archive. Shown on Preprint Exchange and Exabyte Archive. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 29. Power: A blinding white antimatter flash engulfing a captured fortress tower at a city's edge, seen from a distant hillside where onlookers shield their eyes, no mushroom cloud.
rows.note: Written for The Nuclear Option. Shown on The Nuclear Option and Power to the People. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 30. Power: Townspeople hauling solar panels and cable reels onto rooftops, wiring their own grid as the lamps come back on across a district that had gone dark.
rows.note: Written for Power to the People. Shown on The Nuclear Option and Power to the People. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 31. Science: Two researchers in field jackets planting a small instrument mast beside a domed research station on a windy plain, a crate of glowing sample cubes at their feet.
rows.note: Written for Field Grant. Shown on Field Grant and Breakthrough Lab. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 32. Science: A tall cold-store hall of glass shelves, each holding small luminous cubes in rows, a technician sliding one more into place.

rows.label: 33. Science: A crowded corkboard wall of pinned papers in a bright corridor, two scientists swapping a printout and a small glowing cube.
rows.note: Written for Preprint Exchange. Shown on Preprint Exchange and Policy Institute. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 34. Science: A compact server rack in a bright university machine room, fed by a chute of small glowing cubes, a technician watching its status lamps wake row by row.
rows.note: Written for Inference Cluster. Shown on Forensic Audit and Inference Cluster. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 35. Science: A glass-walled hilltop laboratory, a beam from an instrument on its bench lancing out through the open roof and shattering a dark crystal node on the next ridge, researchers shielding their eyes.
rows.note: Written for Breakthrough Lab. Shown on Field Grant and Breakthrough Lab. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 36. Science: A round meeting hall where scientists present a glowing cube model to seated delegates, a banner of linked hands on the wall.
rows.note: Written for Policy Institute. Shown on Preprint Exchange and Policy Institute. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.
